subject: general
question:
**Directions: In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Choose the correct option which best expresses the sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

Help your neighbour.

options.text: You are requested to help your neighbour.
You are ordered to help your neighbour.
You are asked to help your neighbour.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. 'Your neighbour should be helped.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The sentence **'Help your neighbour'** is in Active Voice. It contains **moral suggestions**.

So, sentences containing moral suggestions will take the form of **'Obj + should + be + V₃' ** in the passive voice.

Example:

 
• Donate the poor(Active Voice)⇒**Moral suggestion**
 
• The poor **should be donated (Passive Voice) **

So, the passive voice of the given sentence will be** '*Your neighbour should be helped'* **
